title: Unique Outbound Study Tour | Seattle–Silicon Valley Dual-City AI Immersion
summary: U.S. tech giants keep shipping AI “king bombs” while GenAI carpet-lands across everyday life — and China–U.S. AI debates intensify. Is this only a giants’ game, or can next-gen AI startups co-build the playground? Unique Capital partners lead a dual-city Seattle–Silicon Valley
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Insight / Program · October 18, 2024 · Led by Unique Capital partners

U.S. tech giants keep shipping AI “king bombs” while GenAI carpet-lands across everyday life — and China–U.S. AI debates intensify. Is this only a giants’ game, or can next-gen AI startups co-build the playground? Unique Capital partners lead a dual-city Seattle–Silicon Valley study tour for founders hungry for frontier products and scenes.

Five pillars

  1. Visit Microsoft, Amazon, Nvidia and peers’ frontier AI products
  2. Exchange with U.S. tech founders on product, tech, and GTM
  3. Tour Stanford, University of Washington and other research campuses
  4. Culture: Starbucks first store, Boeing museum, Space Needle, etc.
  5. Walk Silicon Valley / Seattle founder corridors and tech meetups

Stop highlights

Microsoft (Redmond) — FY2023 rev $211.915B; Windows/Office giant. Nov 2023: Altman & Brockman joined to lead a new Microsoft AI team. Jan 24, 2024: market cap hit $3T (second after Apple).

Amazon (Seattle) — Alexa, Lab126, IMDb; Sep 2023 $4B into Anthropic for reliable high-performance foundation models; Nov 29 AWS launched Amazon Q GenAI assistant for enterprise content, search, summaries, multi-app personalization.

FlashIntel.ai — AGI-driven global GTM intel (FlashInfo + FlashClick); founded 2022; 6 countries / 7 offices; 100+ eng/science/GTM; 3,000+ partners; $10M seed (Celtic House, Uphonest, Hat-Trick); Silicon Valley Review Top 50 Most Admired 2023.

Nvidia — full-stack AI compute (CPU/DPU/GPU + software); WAIC top AI leader award; Jul 2020 mkt-cap > Intel; May 2023 first $1T chip firm; Feb 2024 ~$1.83T (then #3 after MSFT/AAPL); Apr 2024 Japan AIST quantum collab.

Collov.ai — AI interior design + home e-commerce (founded 2021, SV HQ + Beijing); personalized VR/AI plans + algorithm-driven shopping; tens of millions USD funding.

Stanford — QS 2024 #5; Bay Area academic + startup hub; SLAC / Hoover. UC Berkeley — QS 2024 #10; public Ivy; U.S. University Association / Global Presidents Forum; UK High Potential Individual visa list.

Culture: Lombard Street, Fisherman’s Wharf / Pier 39, Space Needle, Starbucks first store, Boeing museum, fireside chats, city walks.

Detailed day-by-day itinerary lives in CN image boards (~17 imgs) — attach on import. Enrollment via Unique Capital outbound programs.

— END —
